nodes.label: Default Android Placeholder Launcher Icon (xxxhdpi)
nodes.rationale: This is the stock Android template launcher icon: a white Android robot head silhouette centered on a teal rounded-square background with a faint blueprint grid. Its presence as the xxxhdpi mipmap indicates the app has not replaced the default generated app icon with custom OPC branding, meaning the installable Android build still ships with placeholder branding. Serves as the highest-density square launcher icon (192x192 px reference density) for the React Native/Expo mobile app.
